summary: Lee voted No on most pro-Israel aid and sanctions measures in Congress and publicly framed suppression of Gaza's death toll as 'genocide denial,' yet AIPAC twice thanked her for pro-Israel funding provisions and she voted Yes on the IHRA resolution and a PLO entry ban. As Oakland Mayor she backed halting Israeli military cargo at the Port and stated she has 'long supported Israel's right to exist peacefully.' CAIR Action endorsed her in the general election.
